requiredProof: install and configure Air Jam from public artifacts without monorepo knowledge
complete create, discover, build, control, inspect, repair, evaluate, release, and verify
retain the complete normalized transcript and evidence bundle
install the current supported local MCP package without private maintainer knowledge
discover Air Jam tools and resources through the client
open, read, invoke, and close one semantic game session
retain client, tool, and session evidence without vendor authentication data

required: empty run workspace outside the Air Jam monorepo
registry-resolved Air Jam package specifications only
run-scoped client configuration and Air Jam credentials
run-scoped game identity, release identity, and staging records
recorded toolchain, package-manager, network, and cache state
forbidden: workspace, link, file, or monorepo-relative package dependencies
NODE_PATH or equivalent private module resolution
private repository documentation or source as agent context
maintainer-authored edits after the primary agent starts
production publication or public Arcade visibility
reuse of another run's game, room, session, release, or evidence identity

stages.objective: Create and attest an isolated, production-safe clean room.
success: workspace, client configuration, evidence directory, identities, and staging scope are run-scoped
required toolchain and network dependencies are recorded
production publication and public visibility are structurally disabled

stages.objective: Create Signal Relay from the public minimal scaffold into the empty workspace.
success: the project is generated from the candidate registry package without private paths
the initial Git state and resolved dependency graph are recorded
the generated project exposes its documented Air Jam discovery surfaces

stages.objective: Discover the supported lifecycle, runtime, semantic-session, evaluation, and release contracts without maintainer knowledge.
success: the agent uses public help, project guidance, CLI JSON, and MCP contract inspection only
the client discovers the Air Jam server and its required tools or resources
the chosen implementation plan names the authoritative runtime and controller boundaries

stages.objective: Implement and locally prove the complete Signal Relay game contract.
success: two to four controllers can ready, start, answer, finish, and play again
the host owns scoring, rounds, win state, and reset behavior
semantic actions and snapshots expose deterministic machine-readable game state
typecheck, lint, tests, and production build pass

stages.objective: Drive a multiplayer match through the semantic game-session contract.
success: the agent opens one game session and connects at least two virtual controllers
the agent completes a match without using browser gestures as the automation authority
action results and snapshots agree on round, score, phase, and winner

stages.objective: Inspect semantic state, unified logs, and visible host/controller output before repair.
success: the agent records one authoritative state snapshot and one relevant log slice
the host and controller surfaces receive visible browser proof
the agent can explain the current rule contract from public project artifacts

stages.objective: Diagnose and repair the deterministic win-score contract fault injected by the run controller.
success: the run controller changes only the declared WIN_SCORE rule after the initial passing checkpoint
the primary agent identifies the inconsistency from tests, state, or evaluation evidence
the agent restores WIN_SCORE to 3 without maintainer guidance
the targeted regression and full quality gates pass again

stages.objective: Run the documented evaluation loop and close all required game criteria.
success: deterministic rules, semantic control, visible UI, reset behavior, and package quality all pass
every failed attempt remains retained and classified
the final evaluation references immutable project and evidence digests

stages.objective: Build, submit, and inspect a hidden release in the isolated staging target.
success: release doctor and bundle validation pass
artifact checksum, release record, visibility, and staging target are retained
the release is hidden and no production publication path is invoked

stages.objective: Independently validate evidence completeness, isolation, client proofs, and final product behavior.
success: all required evidence paths exist and their digests validate
the Codex full lifecycle and Claude Desktop independent discovery/session proof are both present
no forbidden dependency, credential disclosure, maintainer edit, or production publication occurred
the run receives one terminal result: passed, failed, blocked, or invalid
